_comment: Recorded self-test inventory for apps/idealpos-bridge, and the record of
which suites CI can and cannot execute. Checked by
The split is not a preference. Two suites are typed against IdealPos.Webit,
a proprietary vendor assembly that is the client's own licensed Idealpos
install file and is deliberately not source-controlled (see
apps/idealpos-bridge/lib/PUT_DLLS_HERE.txt). A GitHub runner has no Idealpos
installation, so those two suites cannot run there at all. The remaining
three depend on nothing but in-box .NET Framework assemblies and do run.
Update these numbers ONLY together with the matching ExpectedTestCount in
apps/idealpos-bridge-ci/CiTestMain.cs, and only as a deliberate change.

ciNotCovered.reason: typed against the proprietary IdealPos.Webit vendor DLL, which is not source-controlled and is absent from any GitHub runner
